mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 76 degrees at Verona Community Park.
The City of Verona has been making strides, recently maintaining a high Aa1 rating from Moody's and officially adopting the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to help manage our local development.
There is plenty to do today, including the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol, live music at Bailey's Run, and the festive Puppets in the Park event at Century School Park.
On September 28, Verona police responded to a two-vehicle accident at CTH-PB and CTH-M where a driver was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake, and with the store currently open until 10:30 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a serving.
